description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ihala Aralugaswewa, Kobeigane D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire a specific parcel of land (0.4846 Hectare in Ihala Aralugaswewa village) for the Divisional Secretariat Kobeigane. It contains detailed land description including cadastral map numbers, block numbers, lot numbers, land names, and claimant information. The notice calls for interested parties to submit compensation claims, which is characteristic of land acquisition procedures. This fits squarely within Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals specifically with land acquisition matters.
